newsitem.title: CHINA: China to boost high-technology product exports.
newsitem.headline: China to boost high-technology product exports.

text.p: China will adopt favourable policies to boost its high-technology exports in 1997, the International Business Daily said on Friday.

"The policies for high-technology exports will be more favourable than for machinery and electrical exports," it said, quoting Wu Zhenquan, vice director of the scientific and technological department of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation (MOFTEC).
MOFTEC and the State Science and Technology Commission were jointly drafting policies to spur technology equipment exports this year, Wu said without elaborating.
China's contracted technology trade volume reached $19.8 billion in 1996, up 27 percent compared with 1995, Wu said.
Technology exoports were $4.5 billion, up 80 percent from 1995 while technology imports were $15.3 billion, up 17 percent, he said.
